description: We are a group of Msc space engineering students at Politecnico di Milano
summary: We developed a comprehensive educational and professional tool to analyze topography data from NASA given a set of limited parameters chosen by the user spanning from sun illumination to earth's communication link availability in order to choose a suitable landing site for the selected mission objectives. The data is displayed for each of the many selected sites both as a function of time and as an average calculated for customizable time interval.
